title: Global Market: Japan's Nikkei falls 3% as oil surge, US rate hike fears weigh - The Economic Times
text:
Japan’s Nikkei fell over 3% in early trade as surging oil prices and rising US Treasury yields revived inflation and rate-hike concerns. Japanese equities came under broad pressure, with 201 Nikkei 225 stocks declining against just 23 gainers.
